leaves.name: finrankGenericEqDegEnd
leaves.doc: GLUE (commutative algebra): for an isogeny psi of an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field, Mathlib's rank Scheme.Hom.finrank of the finite flat morphism psi at the generic point equals degEnd psi = [K(A) : psi^* K(A)]. On an affine chart Spec S -> Spec R (R, S domains, S finite flat over R): rank of S at the prime (0) of R = [Frac S : Frac R]. No abelian-variety input. charpoly-port.
leaves.source: standard commutative algebra (localization of a finite flat module at the generic point); not a literature leaf

note: charpoly-port: charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed (Mumford 19 Thm 4, published LEAF) reduced to one GLUE statement of commutative algebra, in every characteristic: Anthropic FLT's degree polynomial (exists_isHomogeneous_eval_eq_endDegree_of_abelianSchemePropertyBundle, 59 newly vendored modules, standard axioms) gives DegHomogPoly for the kernel-rank degree endDegree; FiniteEndSurjective is proved (finite endomorphism flat by miracle flatness); the remaining comparison endDegree = degEnd at isogenies is finrankGenericEqDegEnd; charpoly-p's charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed_of_degHomogPoly' then gives the field. Needs --allow-rise (one LEAF row becomes one GLUE row). Report docs/research/charpoly-port.md.
